title: Portuguese Conquest of Maricay
text: The Portuguese Conquest of Maricay was a series of battles between the Portuguese Empire under the Iberian Union and the Dutch Republic, taking place in 1623 in the trading post of Maricay, now Gurupá. Taking place one year before the Capture of Bahia, the battle is one of the events leading to thirty years of war between the Portuguese and Dutch in Brazil.
